dedupe_keys.name: chetna power plants unit level inventory with daily generation and co2 emissions for india 2018 2025

description: CHETNA-Power Plants is a unit-level daily record of electricity generation and CO2 emissions for India's power sector from 2018 to 2025. It was published by Chuanlong Zhou. A harmonised plant and unit inventory gives identifiers, location, grid zone, state, installed and monitored capacity, fuel, technology, commissioning and retirement and annual performance for coal, gas and diesel, hydropower and nuclear units. Daily records give gross and net generation, outage indicators and estimated emissions, with flags separating reported values from gap-filled, rescaled or constrained estimates; emissions link daily generation to unit-year emission intensities with uncertainty bounds. Coverage is all major generating units in India at daily resolution. Files are an inventory CSV of about 3 MB, a daily CSV of about 300 MB on Zenodo (latest version August 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: part of the series is gap-filled or modelled, as flagged, and emissions are estimates. Simulation uses are power system modelling, dispatch and outage analysis, and emissions benchmarking in India. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
